scripts.migrate:dev: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] && [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] && [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate deploy
scripts.seed: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] && [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.reset: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] && [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed
